title: SCE is restoring our power
text:
⚡ Power coming back — our circuit (Orion)
SCE is working to turn our power back on; crews inspect the lines first. SCE’s estimate at 7:02 PM: back by Sat, Oct 17, 5 AM.
Downed line? Stay away and call 911.
SCE status: sce.com/outagemap
Live info: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
